tools.name: find_assets
tools.description: Searches the UNIALL index of tokenized real-world assets by free-text query (name, ticker, issuer) and filters for category, chain, issuer, AUM, transfer standard and verification. Results include verified and unverified assets; verified assets rank first. Set verified_only=true to return verified a

tools.name: get_asset_summary
tools.description: Returns a sourced fact sheet for one UNIALL asset by id, including a missing_fields list for unknown values. Useful when you need citable fields for a single asset without inventing data.

tools.name: check_transferability
tools.description: Returns the on-chain transfer restriction standard for a token and, when a wallet address is provided, whether that address can receive it. Useful for transfer-control facts only — not legal eligibility.

tools.name: get_index_stats
tools.description: Returns aggregate UNIALL index counts for assets, verified assets, issuers, chains, deployments, and categories. Useful for a high-level snapshot of index coverage.
